spanish: Estos los contados del tabernáculo, tabernáculo del testimonio, que fue contado sobre boca de Moisés; servicio de los levitas en mano de Itamar hijo de Aarón el sacerdote.
grammarChanges: H4908 is a common noun: replaced the untranslated 'mishkán, mishkán' with 'tabernáculo, tabernáculo' (absolute, then construct), per the cited fail.
Changed 'las contadas' to 'los contados' to agree with the masculine plural construct of the qal participle (h02038021002), per the cited warn.
Changed 'Estas' to 'Estos' so the demonstrative agrees with the corrected masculine 'los contados'.
readerNote: Chose masculine 'los contados' to match the Hebrew participle's grammatical gender, adjusting the demonstrative to 'Estos' for Spanish agreement.
